method.work: fixed total native calls per case and repeat, divided across threads
method.timing: barrier release through all workers completing; thread creation excluded
method.included_costs: native calls, Python loops, prior output destruction, scheduling and barriers
method.correctness: stdlib JSON oracle; warmup and final output of every worker checked outside timing
method.retained_outputs: one final output per worker, released after timing and validation
method.latency: batch wall times only; no per-operation latency distribution
method.scope: one-process local diagnostic; no universal speed or scaling claim
